{"metadata":{"description":"deepseek-harness对live2d的支持","id":"gh:1353571426","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-live2d","slug":"lrplrplrp/dsh-live2d","topics":["deepeek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","live2d"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"deepseek-harness对live2d的支持"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Live2D 看板娘 🎭"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中渲染可拖动的 Live2D 模型，由 DSH 真实工作状态实时驱动动画，并支持眼睛跟随鼠标。**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English · GitHub · [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 功能"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- 🎭 **Live2D 模型渲染** — 在 DSH Web GUI 中显示 Live2D 看板娘
